title: Mushroom Farm Hygiene and Contamination Prevention Activity
location: JKUAT Smart Farm Zone, Juja, Kenya
summary: A practical session focused on identifying contamination risks and improving hygiene practices throughout the mushroom production process.
body: The BRIDGE-AI Kenya team participated in a practical activity focused on hygiene, biosecurity and contamination prevention in mushroom production. Participants examined key areas where contamination can occur, including substrate preparation, handling of mushroom bags, incubation areas and growing rooms. The session emphasized proper cleaning, careful handling of materials, controlled movement within growing areas and early identification of abnormal growth. Participants also discussed how digital monitoring and IoT technologies could support the early detection of unusual environmental conditions that may increase contamination risks. The activity provided practical knowledge that can help improve mushroom production quality, reduce avoidable losses and strengthen farm management practices.
